verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST-based public API v2 with resource-oriented URLs. Authentication is via personal access tokens or OAuth 2.1 with scopes, and the API is available on all plans including Free. It covers programmatic booking, availability, webhook management and user management, and the docs are agent-friendly (llms.txt, Markdown pages, an AI-agent booking guide). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API in practice, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
